notablePrerequisites:
Timestreaming Navigator, Llanowar Elves, and Prime Speaker Vannifar do not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Prime Speaker Vannifar by tapping and sacrificing Llanowar Elves, searching for Timestream Navigator and putting it onto the battlefield.
Cast Llanowar Elves from your graveyard by paying {G}.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
